remarks: Quaint two-bedroom townhouse in historic SONO. Private entry directly into foyer of this spacious townhouse. Open living room/dining combination. Many windows provide natural sunlight. Powder room on main level. Second floor features two, good-sized bedrooms, washer & dryer, pull-down attic and updated full bath w/large stall shower & glass doors. There is a reserved parking space (G) behind the unit. Pet friendly and easy walk to the SONO Collection, SoNO RR and historic Washington Street. Convenient to main highways, beach, many restaurants and shops for easy living. Rental restrictions apply.   A 488 sf ancillary unit w/full bath is available to purchase with this unit for $49,000 (Taxes:$983/HOA's $155). Great for storage, guest room, home office or non-residential rental offering a great income opportunity.
